item.title: Falkland Islands Government Reviews Road Safety in Stanley | Falkland Islands Television
item.description: Road safety was a significant topic of conversation during the latest meeting of the Transport Advisory Committee. The Public Works Department discussed community concerns over traffic on Diamond Jubilee Road and plans to implement a one-way system in parts of the Stanley road network.

item.title: Falkland Islands Represented At Golden Shears And World Championships | Falkland Islands Television
item.description: Falklands competitors performed well at this year’s World Shearing and Woolhandling Championships and Golden Shears in New Zealand. Pilar Castro finished 7th in the semi-finals of the world wool handling, while Adam Dickson placed 2nd in his world shearing heat, later finishing 10th in the semi-finals. item.title: Falkland Islands Youth Football Teams Return From Punta Arenas Tour | Falkland Islands Television
item.description: Staying on the sporting theme, the annual under-16 boys’ and girls’ football tour to Punta Arenas took place last week. Despite a delayed start to the trip, both teams took on a number of sides as the week progressed, allowing them to develop their individual skills and their teamwork.

item.description: The Justice4Patients group will be holding a meeting on Sunday the 15th of March at 4pm at the Chamber of Commerce to help those affected by data breaches at King Edward’s Memorial Hospital to gain financial compensation. item.title: Speed Limit Increase For Falklands MPA Road Discussed Again | Falkland Islands Television
item.description: Speed limits on the MPA Road was once again the topic of conversation during this week’s meeting of the Legislative Assembly. MLA Cheryl Roberts asked MLA Dean Dent about work to increase the limit during last month’s Assembly meeting. More details have since emerged and the question of taking the project forward was discussed.

item.title: Falkland Islands Government Discusses Future Telecoms Picture | Falkland Islands Television
item.description: The future of telecommunications in the Falkland Islands was amongst the topics raised during last week’s Legislative Assembly meeting. item.description: Monday was Commonwealth Day. To mark the occasion, the Commonwealth flag flew beside the Falkland Islands flag on Victory Green - and inside the Town Hall a Youth Parliament was held. item.title: South American Student Competition Winners Visit The Falkland Islands | Falkland Islands Television
item.description: The winners of the Regional Student Competition have visited the Falklands. The competition enables young people from South America to compete for an all-costs-covered trip to the Islands, with the chance to immerse themselves in its culture and way of life. This year, the three people selected came from Uruguay, Paraguay and Argentina.

item.title: International Coach Provides Training For Falkland Islands Archers | Falkland Islands Television
item.description: Archery has always been one of the Falklands’ more notable sports internationally, but those involved have always sought to gain an extra edge on their rivals. This week, they’ve been visited by an experienced coach, with an aim to helping them meet their targets for future success.

item.title: Falkland Islands Mural Unveiled At Malvina House Hotel | Falkland Islands Television
item.description: A mural created during Global Birdfair, a UK conservation event, is now on display at the Malvina House Hotel. Representatives from Falkland Island Holidays, Falklands Conservation and the Falkland Islands Tourist Board attend the Birdfair show annually to promote the Islands’ wildlife and natural environment. item.title: Falklands Cup Returns to Stanley Golf Club | Falkland Islands Television
item.description: The Falklands Cup returned to Stanley Golf Club last weekend, with two teams of 11 competing over two days of challenging conditions. With unpredictable weather and demanding fairways, players were put to the test in one of the Islands’ key golfing events.

item.description: The UK Health Security Agency says an outbreak of Meningitis B in the Kent area has been contained. item.description: On Thursday the 2nd and Friday the 3rd of April, Falkland Islands Operatic and Dramatic Association will be performing their latest production in the Town Hall. item.title: Falkland Islands To Host Workshops Raising Deafblind Awareness | Falkland Islands Television
item.description: A series of workshops encouraging businesses and residents to think about how they can better support deafblind people will be held next week. Organisers say greater awareness is needed and more needs to be done locally to improve accessibility.

item.title: Falkland Islands Unveils 2026 Commonwealth Games Baton At Government House | Falkland Islands Television
item.description: This summer sees the Commonwealth Games take place in Glasgow, with the Falklands represented in bowls. But, before the Games begin, the King’s Baton Relay will take centre stage. This year, each participating nation has been given their own baton to decorate, with ours revealed during a Government House reception this week.
